verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say AI agents can interact with Drata to automate compliance workflows and manage controls through natural language. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented, so natural-language operation is possible through an external AI agent rather than a native in-product interface. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the product itself, detailed docs on which operations work via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.
